title: Do it tomorrow
setting: Early evening, a phone call. Maya is still at work. They had plans to meet tonight.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Hey. So... I feel bad even saying this.
lines.spoken: Hey. So... I feel bad even saying this.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Do you wanna just do it tomorrow? I'm still at work, and it's already... I don't know, it's late, and you're all the way across town.
lines.spoken: D'you wanna just do it tomorrow? I'm still at work, and it's already... I dunno, it's late, and you're all the way across town.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I mean. I can still come. I was just leaving.
lines.spoken: I mean. I can still come. I was just leaving.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You were? I don't want you to feel like you have to. It's rain, it's late, I'm kind of fried.
lines.spoken: You were? I don't want you to feel like you have to. It's rain, it's late, I'm kinda fried.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Yeah, no, tomorrow's probably better. I was kind of hoping you'd say that, if I'm honest.
lines.spoken: Yeah, no, tomorrow's probably better. I was kinda hoping you'd say that, if I'm honest.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Oh my god. Then why were you leaving?
lines.spoken: Oh my god. Then why were you leaving?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Because I said I would. I didn't wanna be the person who cancels.
lines.spoken: 'Cause I said I would. I didn't wanna be the person who cancels.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: We're not canceling. We're moving it. That's different.
lines.spoken: We're not canceling. We're moving it. That's different.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: It is. Okay. Tomorrow. Same place? Or we wanna pick in the morning?
lines.spoken: It is. Okay. Tomorrow. Same place? Or we wanna pick in the morning?

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Let's pick in the morning. I don't even know how I'm gonna feel.
lines.spoken: Let's pick in the morning. I don't even know how I'm gonna feel.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: You too. Sorry I called so last minute.
lines.spoken: You too. Sorry I called so last minute.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Don't be. This is the right call.
lines.spoken: Don't be. This is the right call.

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay. I'll text you tomorrow around ten.
lines.spoken: Okay. I'll text you tomorrow around ten.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Perfect. Go finish whatever you're finishing, then go home.
lines.spoken: Perfect. Go finish whatever you're finishing, then go home.

gist.askEn: What does Maya want to do about tonight?
How does Chris actually feel about it?
accept: he was hoping she'd say that
he didn't want to be the one who cancels

details.askEn: Why does Maya want to move it?

details.askZh: 明天的地点和时间怎么定？
details.askEn: How will they set tomorrow's plan?

glue.span: Do you wanna just do it tomorrow
glue.hear: D'you wanna just do it tomorrow
glue.noteZh: Do you wanna just 压缩得很厉害，这是本包的核心句，先抓住 wanna just do it，再听到 tomorrow。
glue.standard: Do you want to just do it tomorrow

glue.span: I don't want you to feel like you have to
glue.hear: I don't want you to feel like you have to
glue.noteZh: 一长串功能词：don't want you to feel like you have to。实词很少，这正是整句意思容易散掉的地方。
glue.standard: I don't want you to feel like you have to

glue.span: I was kind of hoping you'd say that
glue.hear: I was kinda hoping you'd say that
glue.noteZh: kinda 夹在 was 和 hoping 中间，you'd say that 又有缩约，态度信息全在这团弱音里。
glue.standard: I was kind of hoping you would say that

chunks.sayAfter: I feel bad saying this. Wanna just do it tomorrow?

chunks.form: I don't want you to feel like you have to.
chunks.meaningZh: 我不想让你觉得你非来不可。
chunks.sayAfter: I can still come, but I don't want you to feel like you have to.

chunks.meaningZh: 嗯，其实吧，明天更好。（yeah no 是先应一下，再把话说转。）

roleplay.setupZh: 你们今晚有约，但你还在加班，外面在下雨，你有点耗尽了。你想改到明天，又不想让对方觉得被放鸽子，或觉得他非出门不可。
roleplay.aiRole: Chris, already getting ready to leave, secretly a little relieved if you move it. He didn't want to be the one who cancels. Soft, not guilt-trippy.
variants: Chris would actually still prefer to meet tonight.
They keep tomorrow's place the same.
Maya is also the one who has to commute across town.
mustUse: I don't want you to feel like you have to
starters: I feel bad even saying this.

fluency.promptZh: 讲讲他们为什么没今晚见：Maya 怎么开口，Chris 真实想法是什么，他们怎么区别‘取消’和‘改期’。准备 15 秒，然后 60、45、30 秒。
fluency.promptEn: Tell why they didn't meet tonight: how Maya asked, how Chris really felt, and how they framed it as moving the plan, not canceling. Prep 15 seconds, then 60, 45, 30.
